messages:
maria_r: Quick sync 9 on continuous-batching followup. want to lock down admission shim behavior before prototyping.
akash_k: what are must-haves for v1?
maria_r: minimal: classification -> queue_tag, return opaque slot_token, emit expected_wait_ms_est, no forced routing changes. add metrics only and a probabilistic canary route.
linh_t: workers ignore slot_token until canary enabled?
maria_r: yes. workers treat it as optional. when enabled, worker may call KV.Pin(slot_token) for warmups. missing token -> mark exec_cold.
sam_sre: ops asks for explicit metrics: admission_enqueues_total, admission_rejects_total{reason}, worker_execs_total{exec_cold}, warmup_attempts_total, warmup_dropped_total, queue_circuit_tripped_total.
akash_k: implement two routing knobs: base_prob and surge_prob (surge when queue growth > X). also add probabilistic smoothing to avoid thrashing.
linh_t: warmup dedupe: short in-memory cache keyed by (model,queue_tag,slot_prefix) with ~200ms window. cap warmup concurrency per-GPU.
maria_r: rollout plan: (A) FF telemetry-only 72h, (B) 1% queue_tag routing in staging + simulator, (C) enable slot_token warmups for canary tenants, (D) enable circuit-breaker & fastpath ramp. each step needs dashboards and rollback playbook.
sam_sre: rollback: flip ff off per-region => legacy shaper. verify queues drain <5m; if not kill worker processes. add runbook.
akash_k: prototype admission shim in Rust. expose shared-memory for per-worker cheap reads, fallback to RPC if missing. microbenchmark target <500ns.
linh_t: preemption not in v1. rely on DrainHint and early-flush opt-in. document as future work.
maria_r: API sketch for docs:
POST /v1/admit
body: { model: string, token_count: int, urgency?: "interactive"|"normal"|"low", cache_hint?: "warm"|"none", policy_id?: string }
resp: { enqueued: true|false, slot_token?: string, queue_tag: string, expected_wait_ms_est: int }
sam_sre: add tracing span "admission.enqueue" and carry traceparent inside slot_token to correlate traces.
maria_r: failure mode: lost slot_token -> worker treats as cold-exec and increments slot_token_loss_total; SLA target <0.1%.
akash_k: will prototype and attach bench numbers. linchpin: keep shim cheap and stateless.
maria_r: I'll draft RFC follow-up with telemetry table, rollout steps, and ops checklist. please review by EOD.
